author: Inside Edition
description: Sy Moran has dedicated his life to snowboarding and transitioned from being a professional athlete to coaching. But a freak accident in April has halted his career. While riding a chairlift, he had a seizure and fell 40 feet. He suffered several catastrophic injuries, including paralysis. To save his life, surgeons also amputated his leg. He hopes his story will raise awareness and encourage people to use the safety bar when riding chairlifts. To donate to his GoFundMe, visit https://www.gofundme.com/f/support-sys-journey-to-recovery-and-rehabilitation
title: Seizure Causes Snowboarder To Fall From Ski Lift
